card.name: Add-on methods and combination use
card.fires_on: Words ending a phrase about using something together with or in addition to another measure, such as backup contraception methods, or 'in combination with' another drug or therapy.

modes.label: Added contraception
modes.description: Words like contraception, methods or barrier in advice to use extra or nonhormonal birth control.

modes.label: In combination with
modes.description: The word with, or the partner term, after 'in combination' for drug or therapy pairings.
modes.example: VOCABRIA is indicated for use in combination<< with>> EDUR

modes.label: Used alongside diet or therapy
modes.description: A noun naming the thing a drug is taken or used together with.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning 'paired with', 'complement' and 'alone', pushing toward text about use together with something else.
card.plain: It lights up when the label says to use a drug together with, or in addition to, another method or treatment.
